title: Procedure
description: Stage 2+ artifact: the canonical step sequence for completing the task shown in one video. Stage 1 defines the field specification only; no semantic content is produced at this stage.

video_id.description: ID of the source video (matches the video filename stem).

task.description: Short description of the overall task, e.g. 'bake a cake'.

order.description: 1-based position of the step in the canonical procedure.

instruction.description: Canonical instruction text for this step.

depends_on.description: step_ids that must be completed before this step.

expected_outcome.description: Observable state indicating the step succeeded.
